=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:2694,26866-26869 (with scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1032-1041, scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:23737-23754) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The attempt_merge chain passes a non-empty `.head.ref` as PR_CHECKS_HEAD_REF, so `_pr_ensure_final_ci` skips its fork-head rejection, and the resolver never checks `.head.repo`.
  WHY: A fork PR whose head ref names a base-repo branch can cause final CI to be dispatched on the wrong ref. The chain then reports "in flight" forever and never escalates, and one reviewer says fork-controlled code could run with the repo token. Severity disagreement: BLOCKER (gemini), MAJOR (sonnet, luna, glm), NIT (minimax); highest used.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:26902-26910 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The lease-wait branch logs `reason=${STALL_MERGE_REFUSAL_REASON:-base_not_fresh}`. Gemini says successful merges are logged as refusals. Sonnet and minimax say the fallback is unreachable.
  WHY: Severity disagreement: MAJOR (gemini), NIT (sonnet, minimax). The gemini claim is disputed, because lease_wait always co-occurs with a base_not_fresh refusal.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:1481,1720 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: REVIEW_FINAL_CI_WORKFLOW is exported to the whole poller step, so other paths (the noop-suspicious gate and the base-sync final-CI dispatch) now dispatch final CI even when STALL_MERGE_REQUIRED_CHECKS_ENABLED=false.
  WHY: The "false restores the previous chain exactly" claim is inaccurate, and extra runner dispatches are added. Severity disagreement: MAJOR (luna), NIT (sonnet, glm).
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:1475-1484,1714-1723 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: REVIEW_FINAL_CI_WORKFLOW is set only when the repository is shubhodeep1/coding-workflows, so consumers get an empty value and no final-CI dispatch. The owner/repo string is also hardcoded.
  WHY: Consumers may stay blocked on checks_incomplete. Sonnet says this is documented behaviour and not a defect. Severity disagreement: MAJOR (gemini), NIT (minimax, sonnet).
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:32469-32648 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new #9732 tests are marked "not run" or "unverified: timeout", so the behaviour has no passing run. The pre-push gate also attributes failures in several unrelated tests and shellcheck to this change, and no reviewer could map them to a diff hunk.
  WHY: Regressions could ship untested. Severity disagreement: BLOCKER (gemini), MAJOR (glm, confidence 3 for the attribution part).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:2693 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: PR_FINAL_CI_REASON="" is assigned but never read.
  WHY: It is dead code and would trigger SC2034 at warning severity only. Severity: NIT.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:2604-2626 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `|| flag_norm=""` fallback in `_stall_merge_required_checks_enabled` is unreachable, because flag_norm is already initialised to "".
  WHY: It implies an error-recovery path that cannot run. Severity: NIT.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:2706-2708 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: All non-zero returns from `_orch_squash_merge_bound` collapse into merge_call_failed.
  WHY: The unresolved_head_sha distinction would be lost for a future caller. Severity: NIT.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:2694 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: When merge_head_ref is empty, the helper silently does its own pulls/<pr> read.
  WHY: The extra API call is not logged. Severity: NIT.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:26911-26925 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: After a successful merge the else branch logs "attempted merge retry" and sets STALL_RECOVERY_SHOULD_INCREMENT=true.
  WHY: It matches the legacy behaviour, so it is not a regression, but a success looks like a retry in the logs. Severity: NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "In .github/workflows/internal-orchestrate-poll.yml, give the poll step REVIEW_FINAL_CI_WORKFLOW: ci.yml, the same value as the sweep."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/internal-orchestrate-poll.yml
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The PR sets the variable in orchestrate_poll.yml:1481 and :1720 instead, because internal-orchestrate-poll.yml only calls orchestrate_poll.yml@promote-candidate. The deviation is documented in agents.d/9732-stall-merge-required-checks.md, so the intent is met. Both reviewers rate it NIT.
- requirement: Add tests in tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py covering the new behaviour (lease-wait with a successful chain, and the fail-closed branch at line 2676).
  expected_change_site: tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: Gemini says no test sets PR_BASE_FRESHNESS_OUTCOME="lease_wait" together with a successful chain return, and rates it MAJOR. Minimax says the line 2676 fail-closed branch and the helper-level lease-wait branch are not exercised, and rates it NIT. Sonnet says all six tests are present but timed out in the gate, and rates it NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:2694,~26869 (23987-24049, 23737-23754; pr_checks_lib.sh 1032-1041) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: merge_head_ref is passed as PR_CHECKS_HEAD_REF, so the fork_head rejection is skipped, and the resolver does not check .head.repo.
  WHY: A fork PR with head ref ai/issue-<n> can have CI dispatched on the wrong ref. The chain then reports "in flight" forever and never escalates. The fix is to pass an empty head_ref unless .head.repo.full_name equals GITHUB_REPOSITORY.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:26902-26910 (26907) | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The base_not_fresh fallback is defensive only, and no path triggers it.
  WHY: It does not fail, so the consensus "major" severity is not supported.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:2693 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: PR_FINAL_CI_REASON is assigned but never read.
  WHY: Only SC2034 at default severity would flag it. The shellcheck gate failure is not explained by this line.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:1481,1720 (README.md, agents.d/9732-stall-merge-required-checks.md, changelog.d/9732-stall-merge-required-checks.md) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: REVIEW_FINAL_CI_WORKFLOW is exported to the whole poller step, but the flag disables only the attempt_merge chain.
  WHY: New dispatches may occur on other paths, which could surprise someone rolling back. This is a documentation and rollback-scope nit.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:1481,1720 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: This repeats the fork-ref concern. In consumers the value is empty, which is documented behaviour.
  WHY: It adds nothing new.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "In .github/workflows/internal-orchestrate-poll.yml, give the poll step REVIEW_FINAL_CI_WORKFLOW: ci.yml".
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/internal-orchestrate-poll.yml.
  Evidence of absence: The variable is set in orchestrate_poll.yml instead, and the deviation is documented. The intent is met.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 2
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Add tests in tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py", with the six red-on-base tests.
  Expected change site: tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py.
  Evidence of absence: All six tests are present. The gate could not run them because the file timed out.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 2
- Gate failures (tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py, tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py, tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py, tests/test_session_start_extract_repo_slug.py, tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py, shellcheck) cannot be mapped to a hunk, so no code finding was raised. Re-run on the head to check for a baseline mismatch.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh ~26869: read .head.repo.full_name and set merge_head_ref empty unless it equals GITHUB_REPOSITORY (about 3 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:26903-26904,26914 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The code dispatches final CI using an unverified head_ref from the PR JSON, with no check that the head is in this repository.
  WHY: A fork PR with a colliding head ref can trigger ci.yml via workflow_dispatch and cancel ongoing CI on the real PR head.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:26907-26910 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The refusal logging block defaults the reason to base_not_fresh when the chain succeeds, so successful merges are logged as refusals.
  WHY: Operators misread the logs, and metrics and recovery budget counts would be corrupted.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:1475-1484,1714-1723 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: REVIEW_FINAL_CI_WORKFLOW is set only for shubhodeep1/coding-workflows and is empty for consumers.
  WHY: Consumer stall recovery remains blocked on checks_incomplete indefinitely.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:32469-32648 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new #9732 tests are marked "not run" or "unverified: timeout".
  WHY: The new behavioural contract is untested and unverified, so regressions could ship.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:26903 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: PR_FINAL_CI_REASON is assigned but never read.
  WHY: It is dead code that adds confusion during debugging.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:2604-2626 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `|| flag_norm=""` fallback is dead code, because flag_norm is initialised to "".
  WHY: It implies a recovery path that cannot trigger.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Add tests in tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py covering the new behaviour.
  Expected change site: tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py
  Evidence of absence: No test sets PR_BASE_FRESHNESS_OUTCOME="lease_wait" together with a successful new-chain return.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

  PROBLEM: The `|| flag_norm=""` fallback is dead code.
  WHY: It does not fail, but it suggests an error-recovery path that cannot occur.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:2693 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: PR_FINAL_CI_REASON="" is unused in `_standalone_attempt_merge_required_checks`.
  WHY: It does not fail. SC2034 would flag it, but CI uses --severity=error.
